reason: PURE. The first thing I noticed was the pocket-size sachet with the 2 capsules already counted, which saves me the weekly organizer routine before trips, and the QR batch report is a nice extra. I would try one box for the gym bag and car, but the foil packets still feel wasteful to me.
objection: No reviews on a new brand, and $1 a day in foil packets is a lot more than a bottle of bisglycinate where I count my own capsules. I also hate the waste of 30 single-use packets.
would_change_my_mind: A few hundred real reviews, or a lower price per serving (around $22 a box), or a recyclable sachet.
